classes.name: Posredni izbor gradonačelnika (Mostar, Grad Sarajevo, Brčko distrikt)
classes.name_en: Mayors chosen by their councils
classes.disposition_reason: The City Council of Mostar (Art. 19.7), the City Council of Sarajevo (Art. 13.10), and the Brčko District Assembly choose these mayors by a vote of their members; there is no public ballot.

classes.name: Posredni izbori za Gradsko vijeće Grada Sarajeva i Skupštinu Grada Istočno Sarajevo
classes.name_en: City councils elected by municipal councils (Sarajevo, Istočno Sarajevo)
classes.note: Elected by the councils of the constituent municipalities within 15 days of their constitution (Art. 13.10, 13.12); the CEC confirms the result and allocates the mandates.

dates.note: Indirect elections after each local election; not yet listed by date.
Held in December 2016 and January 2017 after the 2016 local elections; listed under the local election date.

classes.name: Lokalni referendumi
classes.name_en: Municipal referendums
classes.disposition_reason: Called by municipal assemblies under entity law and run by municipal commissions; no central register of local referendums or their results exists.

classes.name: Izbori za savjete mjesnih zajednica
classes.name_en: Local community councils
classes.disposition_reason: Elected at residents' meetings or ballots organized by each municipality under its own statute; the CEC does not administer them and no body publishes their results.

classes.name: Referendum o nezavisnosti Bosne i Hercegovine
classes.name_en: 1992 independence referendum
classes.note: Voting on 29 February and 1 March 1992, run by the Republic Election Commission of SR BiH.
classes.disposition_reason: The official result was published in the Službeni list RBiH; no official online copy was found, and the CEC archive starts in 1996.

dates.note: Voting on 29 February and 1 March 1992.

classes.name: Izbori za članove Predsjedništva SR Bosne i Hercegovine (1990)
classes.name_en: Presidency of SR Bosnia and Herzegovina (1990)
classes.note: Seven members (two Muslims, two Serbs, two Croats, one Other) by popular vote on 18 November 1990, the first multiparty election.
classes.disposition_reason: Results were published by the Republic Election Commission in the Službeni list SRBiH; no official online copy was found.

classes.name: Izbori za Skupštinu SR Bosne i Hercegovine
classes.name_en: Assembly of SR Bosnia and Herzegovina
classes.note: The 1990 election chose the Chamber of Citizens (130) and the Chamber of Municipalities (110), with runoffs on 2 December 1990. From 1945 to 1986 the assembly was chosen in single-list and, from 1974, delegate elections.
classes.disposition_reason: Results exist only in the printed Službeni list (N)RBiH/SRBiH and reports of the republic election commissions; no official online copy was found.

dates.note: Chamber of Citizens (130) and Chamber of Municipalities (110); runoffs on 2 December 1990.
Assembly elections of the People's Republic and Socialist Republic, not yet listed by date.

classes.name: Izbori za skupštine općina u SR Bosni i Hercegovini
classes.name_en: Municipal assemblies of SR Bosnia and Herzegovina
classes.note: Held with the republic election on 18 November 1990 (and earlier under the socialist delegate system).
classes.disposition_reason: Municipal results of 1990 were published by the municipal election commissions; no official online copy was found.

classes.name: Wahlen zum Bosnisch-hercegovinischen Landtag (Sabor)
classes.name_en: Diet (Sabor) of Bosnia and Herzegovina, 1910
classes.note: 72 elected members chosen by confessional curiae in May 1910 under the Landesstatut of 17 February 1910; the Diet sat until 1914 and no further election was held.
classes.disposition_reason: Results by curia and constituency survive only in the period's official gazettes and Landtag papers; the digitized gazette host refused connections when checked on 16 November 2026, and no other official copy was found.
